# Introduction

Focus on advice released in autumn 2026
* UK 2018 to 2023 commercial landings and discards updates for rja.27.nea, rjc.27.7afg, rje.27.7fg, rjh.27.7afg included


Follow-ups from WKSKATE2 noted
* Cuckoo ray 4-3.a revised length for exploitable B (30 instead of 50 cm), reference levels recalculated
* Blond ray 7.e exploratory work conducted, requires further discussion
* Thornback ray 7.e preliminary work may lead to a new model based index in the 2028 assessment
* Spotted ray 6 7.b 7.j included a new survey
* rjc.27.7afg revised length for exploitable B (30 instead of 50 cm), reference levels recalculated
* rjm.27.7ae-h revised length for exploitable B (30 instead of 50 cm), reference levels recalculated
* rjm.27.67bj added an index, reference levels recalculated
* rje.27.7fg revised length for exploitable B (30 instead of 50 cm), reference levels recalculated
* rjb.27.67a-ce-k potential to split into common blue skate and flapper skate for future assessments


Update on ICES work on Spurdog (*Squalus acanthias*)

Brief review of multiannual advice released previously

```{r getdat, eval=FALSE}

# run the script that reads the advice sheets to fill out the slides and save the dataset

source(here::here("Projects/ICES_ACOM/NWWAC/R/ReadAdviceSheet_Fig1Title.R"))

files <- list.files("~/Documents/Work/ICES-ACOM/AdviceSheets/Elasmobranchs2026", pattern = "\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
all_results <- purrr::map(files, purrr::possibly(extract_ices_advice, otherwise = NULL, quiet = FALSE)) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

saveRDS(all_results, here::here("Projects/ICES_ACOM/NWWAC/advicedat/2026_elasmos.rds"))

# all_results |> dplyr::select(-catch_advice, -catch_scenarios, -forecast_values, -reference_points)
# all_results |> dplyr::select(stock_code, catch_advice)     |> tidyr::unnest(catch_advice)
# all_results |> dplyr::select(stock_code, catch_scenarios)  |> tidyr::unnest(catch_scenarios)
# all_results |> dplyr::select(stock_code, forecast_values)  |> tidyr::unnest(forecast_values)
# all_results |> dplyr::select(stock_code, reference_points) |> tidyr::unnest(reference_points)

```


```{r, include=FALSE}

all_results <- readRDS(here::here("advicedat/2026_elasmos.rds"))

stocks <- unique(all_results$stock_code)

```


---
```{r, results='asis'}

st <- all_results |> dplyr::filter(stock_code == stocks[3])
st_scen <- st |> dplyr::select(stock_code, catch_scenarios)  |> tidyr::unnest(catch_scenarios)
#![Advice Fig 1](https://github.com/sgaichas/HSpresentations/raw/main/{{ st$figure_png }})

src <- knitr::knit_expand(text = c(
    "background-image: url(\"https://github.com/sgaichas/HSpresentations/raw/main/{{ st$figure_png }}\")",
    "background-size: 900px",
    "background-position: bottom 30px left -20px",
    "## {{ st$title }}",
    "",
    "Advice for `r unlist({{ st$catch_advice }})[[1]]` and `r unlist({{ st$catch_advice }})[[2]]` `r unlist({{ st$catch_advice }})[[6]]` <= `r unlist({{ st$catch_advice }})[[4]]` t",
    ".pull-left-70[",
    "",
    "",
    ".footnote[ {{ st$advice_url }}]",
    "]",
    "",
    ".pull-right-30[",
    "{{ st$fishing_pressure }}",
    "",
    "{{ st$stock_size }}",
    "",
    "{{ st$advice_change_note }}",
    "",
    "]",
    "---",
    "## {{ st$title }}",
    "",
    "Total landings ({{ st$catch_year }}):  {{ st$landings_t }} t, {{ st$catch_dist_note }}",
    "",
    "```{r}",
    "#| echo: false",
    "st_scen |>",
    "dplyr::select(!c(1:3)) |>",
    "flextable::flextable() |>",
    "flextable::autofit()",
    "```",
    "",
    ".footnote[ {{ st$advice_url }}]",
    "---"))
res <- knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE)
cat(res, sep = '\n')
```
